verdict.rationale: Rootly's Workflows engine runs structured actions automatically on trigger events and run conditions, backed by 152 action types, including AI actions. AI SRE investigation rules also let it investigate matching alerts automatically, and Meeting Scribe joins bridges on its own, so configurable background automation is well documented. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of autonomous background runs, documented time-based/recurring schedule triggers (evidence covers event triggers only).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Workflows are Rootly's automation engine. They let you run structured actions automatically (or manually) based on: **Trigger events**
Automation that runs your response: channels created, stakeholders updated, tickets filed, retros started, the same way every time.
Investigation rules decide which alerts Rootly AI SRE investigates automatically and which alert-specific instructions it applies
Reference for all 152 Rootly workflow action types, grouped by category: Slack, Google Chat, Jira, on-call, AI, and incident operations.
Meeting Scribe joins the bridge automatically and preserves the call as a live, searchable, speaker-labeled record attached to the incident.
